_what: RE-MEASUREMENT of set-05's mount signature after the shipped two-window probe returned NO SOLUTION. Same instruments, one different input frame.

why_the_shipped_probe_failed.mechanism: mount_probe.sh's WINDOW RULE selects the FIRST and LAST frame of the longest contiguous capture run. It is a boundary rule (a re-aim can only happen across a run boundary) and it is BLIND TO FRAME QUALITY. set-05's capture run ENDS inside cloud block 4 (DSC_5196-5253), so window B was DSC_5253.
why_the_shipped_probe_failed.measured: window A DSC_4676 SOLVED (logodds 114). Window B DSC_5253 yielded only 96 stars to the extractor (sep/SExtractor core) and returned NO SOLUTION. The chain then reported 'mount underivable' and exited 4 — which reads as a MOUNT problem and is a CLOUD problem.
why_the_shipped_probe_failed.generality: any set whose capture run ends (or begins) inside an obscuration hits this. The set's own frame QA already knows which frames are clean; the window rule does not consult it. NOT FIXED HERE — a change to a shipped build-path script is the owner's call under the standing no-change-without-A/B rule.

method: identical to mount_probe.sh: Siril 1.4.4 `load <raw>` + `extract_Green` -> scripts/calibrate/solve_field.py (astrometry.net, blind, sep/SExtractor core). The ONLY difference is which frame supplies the second window.

C.why_this_frame: the LAST frame of set-05 outside every flagged cloud run (n=517); maximises separation while staying solvable

field_centres._convention: WCS evaluated AT THE CENTRE PIXEL of the solved green plane — never CRVAL, which is the tangent point (BACKLOG:pointing-record-names-the-wrong-frame). Reading CRVAL here gives 0.90x sidereal and a false CONTRADICT.

result.verdict: FIXED — RA advances at sidereal to 0.17%, Dec constant to 37 arcsec over 25.8 min. Same signature the other four sets of this session measured independently (set-01 15.0784 deg/hr).

corroboration: sets 01-04 of this session each derived 'fixed' from their OWN two-window solves, and set-05 is contiguous with them in frame number (DSC_2276-5253, no gaps) and separated from set-04 by 6 minutes. Five independent measurements.

route_key_also_blocked_and_why.what_happened: the same NO SOLUTION on DSC_5253 blocks the ROUTE key as well as the mount: fingerprint.inter_frame_drift stays empty, so drift_frac (sky excursion / field) cannot be computed and run_set_chain.sh exits 5 'route still underivable'.

derived_from_this_record_instead.verdict: 0.1916 >= 0.05 -> undistort-groups, by the same rule the chain applies
derived_from_this_record_instead.corroboration: the other four sets of this session derived drift_frac 0.198 on identical geometry (same field, mount, lens, 28.6 deg field); set-01 measured 5.67 deg over 1797 s against this set's 5.481 deg over 1731 s — the same rate

route_key_also_blocked_and_why.action: run with --route=groups, a documented CLI override, rather than letting an unsolvable frame pick the route. The override asserts what this record MEASURED; it does not substitute judgement for a measurement.
